reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is transforming an unstructured corpus of 1,115 scientific papers into a structured knowledge base. We achieve this via a four-worker distributed pipeline: each worker independently extracts equations from a paper, and only those equations agreed upon by at least two models are written to the final index. This two-model agreement acts as a robustness filter, eliminating spurious or noisy symbol strings while retaining genuine mathematical relationships. The protocol enforces strict deadlines (14:16 CT) to prevent cascading delays; a file missing from the registry at that time is flagged as a permanent failure, not a resolvable issue. Historical replay ensures that the indexing procedure is reproducible at any prior point in time, enabling consistent performance monitoring.
